document.title: Medicare Benefits Schedule (MBS) - Items by Patient Demographics Report

resources.name: MBS Patient Demographics 2016 Qtr 3 (July)
resources.description:
Data is updated monthly 


*  Quarter 3 contains data for the period 1 July to 31 July 2016.



*  The figures in the report include only those services that are performed by a registered provider, for services that qualify for Medicare Benefit and for which a claim has been processed by Medicare Australia. They do not include services provided by hospital doctors to public patients in public hospitals or services that qualify for a benefit under the Department of Veterans' Affairs National Treatment Account.



*  State/Territory is determined according to the address (at the time of claiming) of the patient to whom the service was rendered.



*  Month is determined by the date the service was processed by Medicare Australia, not the date the service was provided.



*  The figures are made up of total services claimed minus later day adjustments. A later day adjustment is a reversal of a previously claimed service and can occur for a number of reasons. In some months the number of later day adjustments exceeds new claims for an item. In these circumstances, the total figure for the month will be negative. 


*  Monthly figures may vary due to the varying number of processing days in a month, which depends on the number of days in the month, public holidays, overtime worked etc.



*  If you require statistics at a more detailed level, please contact statistics@humanservices.gov.au detailing your request. Medicare Australia charges on a cost recovery basis for providing more detailed statistics and their provision is subject to privacy considerations.

requirements.requirement: Bind every semantic result to an approved raw digest, receipt, acquisition ID, exact source era and source-specific rights decision.
requirements.boundary: No additional source, revision or publication authority is implied.

requirements.requirement: Inventory exact CSV headers, XLSX table regions and archive-member metadata before choosing native schema mappings and row grain.
requirements.boundary: CKAN field names/types are candidate hints; exclude no native field without hosted evidence and do not treat CKAN _id as producer identity.

requirements.requirement: Retain native coordinates, tokens, presence, formulas and markers; distinguish absent, empty, zero, suppressed and unknown values.
requirements.boundary: Unknown historical suppression conventions stay unqualified; never fill suppressed/missing data with zero.

requirements.requirement: Select exact numeric profiles from native evidence; preserve signed service totals and benefit precision with no floating-point loss.
requirements.boundary: Negative adjusted service totals are documented and must not fail solely for being negative; do not infer a distinct-patient denominator.

requirements.requirement: Qualify native Year/processing-month tokens and calendar mapping separately from reporting labels and source clocks.
requirements.boundary: Catalogue notes identify processing time, not service dates; no publication/effective date inferred from period or retrieval.

requirements.requirement: Preserve native state, age range and gender labels and unknown/suppressed states.
requirements.boundary: Catalogue geography describes patient address at claiming; no provider-location or population-denominator inference.

requirements.requirement: Reconcile per-resource documented coverage with native payload/member periods before any comparison.
requirements.boundary: Q2 CSV is documented through May while XLSX covers April-June; group YTD July does not establish its start date; archive filenames are not coverage proof.

requirements.requirement: Preserve item/group/subgroup identifiers lexically and bind them to their source period and schema era.
requirements.boundary: Item identifiers may change; no current-schedule mapping, medicine identity or clinical assertion is implied.

requirements.requirement: Define grain from native headers and metadata, report duplicate/overlap findings, and validate only source-supplied totals over compatible periods.
requirements.boundary: Do not silently deduplicate or force unlike CSV/XLSX cut-offs or demographic groups to reconcile.

requirements.requirement: Carry documented registered-provider/eligible-processed-service scope and public-patient/DVA exclusions with qualified tables.
requirements.boundary: No whole-population, current availability, funding entitlement or unique-person claim follows from service statistics.

requirements.requirement: Record semantic outcomes separately, then join real source/storage/lineage evidence and the existing Bronze admission protocol per object.
requirements.boundary: Historical import references cannot fabricate missing native SourceReceipt/storage controls; no object admitted by this metadata review.

requirements.requirement: Use main-only protected Actions with bounded workers, public-safe aggregate receipts and independent readback before cleanup.
requirements.boundary: Only exact eligible objects dispatch; oversized ZIP holds remain independent and infrastructure failures remain inconclusive.

next_step: Implement a protected, exact-reference header inventory for the four previously structurally verified standalone CSV objects. Emit native header metadata and counts, never data records; select no historical ZIP or workbook in that first step.
